tolerances.area: absolute, areaTolerance = delta * boundaryLength of the repaired geometry
tolerances.membership: sample points farther than margin from the repaired boundary must have the same inside state; a symmetric difference of area S would contain about S / bboxArea of the samples, and all mismatching samples would lie within delta of the boundary, so zero mismatches certify symmetric difference <= delta * boundaryLength up to sampling
tolerances.derivation: coordinates in [0, 11], float32 ulp <= 2^-20 = 9.5e-7. Crossing points have error <= about 4 ulp amplified by 1 / sin(0.2 rad) = 5.0 (crossings below 0.2 rad are rejected): 1.9e-5 <= delta = 2e-5. The area error is at most delta times the boundary length; margin = 5 delta.
